bukti: a citrus classification dataset comprising 10,000 samples (5,000 oranges and 5,000 grapefruits) characterized by 5 features (diameter, weight, and RGB color values)
a crop yield dataset spanning 1990-2022 from 39 countries across Africa (17 countries, 1,122 records) and the Americas (22 countries, 1,452 records)
catatan: Data tabular, bukan citra buah di pohon; hasil panen dimodelkan dari fitur lingkungan dan hara tingkat negara tanpa deteksi buah. E2 juga dapat dipakai untuk bagian pemutuan.

bukti: This study proposed the YOLO-CIT (You Only Look Once-Citrus) model and integrated an innovative R-LBP (Roughness-Local Binary Pattern) method to accurately identify citrus fruits at distinct ripeness stages.
a Precision of 88.13%, a Recall of 93.16%, an F1 score of 90.89, a mAP@0.5 of 85.88%, and 6.1ms of average detection speed for citrus fruit ripeness identification in complex environments
catatan: Deteksi buah di pohon dengan atribut kelas kematangan dari citra tunggal; abstrak tidak melaporkan pencacahan, hanya metrik deteksi. Dikodekan C4 karena protokol memasukkan deteksi beratribut kelas; bila C4 mensyaratkan hitungan eksplisit, alternatifnya X/E5.

c1.hasil_ringkas: Pada satu contoh, video penerbangan rendah di dekat satu pohon jeruk kecil dengan 12 buah diproses dan seluruh 12 buah terpulihkan; tidak ada metrik galat hitung lain yang dilaporkan.

bukti: a robust workflow for fruit detection and counting using RGB images. We validate our approach through fruit counting with canopy-level aerial images

[parafrasa web] Detected fruits are tracked (ByteTrack in place of the Hungarian Algorithm) and fed to structure-from-motion with COLMAP; density-based spatial clustering groups reconstructed landmarks by individual fruits.
[parafrasa web] A video captured during a low-altitude flight near a small orange tree with 12 fruits is processed, and the method accurately recovers all 12 fruits.
catatan: Abstrak tidak menyebut mekanisme asosiasi; M3+M4 diambil dari versi arXiv (pelacakan ByteTrack lalu SfM COLMAP dan pengelompokan landmark 3D). Validasi hitung hanya satu pohon; sumber acuan 12 buah tidak dinyatakan tegas, diasumsikan hitungan di pohon. Kontribusi utama makalah adalah navigasi UAV.

bukti: the YOLOv8+ model is proposed for identifying ripe and unripe strawberries and extracting ripe strawberry targets in images
The accuracy of the image processing method for classifying ripe strawberries was 91.91%, FPR was 5.03%, and FNR was 14.28%.
quickly and accurately identify strawberries at different stages of ripeness in a facility environment
catatan: Deteksi stroberi di tanaman (lingkungan fasilitas) dengan kelas kematangan dari citra tunggal; yang dihitung adalah piksel merah, bukan jumlah buah. Dikodekan C4 karena protokol memasukkan deteksi beratribut kelas; bila C4 mensyaratkan hitungan buah, alternatifnya X/E5.

c1.hasil_ringkas: YOLOv4-512 dengan Deep SORT pada satu video ponsel 32 detik: metode ID unik mencapai F1count 87,85% dan MOTA 75,47%, sedangkan metode garis ROI mencapai F1count 72,94% dan MOTA 56,60%. AP@0,50 deteksi terbaik 98% (YOLOv4-CSP).

bukti: Deep SORT, in combination with YOLOv4, was implemented locally to track the pears in an unseen test mobile phone video of resolution 1080 × 1920, 32 s long
For the second method, the counts were based on the number of unique object IDs generated by Deep SORT’s tracking mechanism.
it also integrated a deep appearance‐based metric derived from the convolutional neural network
catatan: Deep SORT dikodekan M2+M3 sesuai konvensi. Acuan hitung tidak dinyatakan tegas; TP/FP/FN hitungan dinilai pada video uji, sehingga diisi anotasi. Evaluasi hitung hanya pada satu video.
